scope: local amd64 public process qualification with loopback upstream and object fixtures and real PostgreSQL 18
observations: Default production entrypoint exits 1 with only startup_failed for missing configuration and unavailable attached identity while networking is disabled.
Pinned MCP client discovers and calls all three tools; citation and quote are verified against HTTP fixture sources.
SIGTERM during the opinion request allows completion and a zero exit within ten seconds.

SIGKILL exits 137 without OOM, preserves three charged attempts and publishes no ready opinion object.
Named container SQL connections exist before SIGKILL and disappear afterward.
Both container log streams exclude fixture source text, API-key prefixes, upstream token and pepper.
